text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Takamatsunomiya Kinen 
drawing near. Just as I finished our usual 
meeting with K.S.Miracle—

A polite yet distinct knock brought me 
back to my senses.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, Ruby. Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san. And Trainer-san. I have 
something to discuss with both of you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I know how busy you must be with the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen approaching, but—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Would it be possible to spare a little 
time next weekend?

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Now then, allow me to introduce them. The 
crimson jewel of the illustrious "Noble 
Family," Lady Daiichi Ruby. And next—

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Here to enter are the miraculous 
speedster, K.S. Miracle, and her Trainer. 
Please welcome them with a round of 
applause.
(Clap clap clap clap clap...!!)

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ruby, right this way, please. Lady 
Miracle, Trainer, thank you very much for 
taking the time to come today.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No... um, is it really okay? Setting aside 
you, Trainer... is it really alright for 
someone like me to be invited to such a 
fancy place?
choice_data_list: I'm pretty out of place here too, y'know!?
I'm totally out of place here too!?

text_block_list.text:
I retorted reflexively, then looked around 
the room once more. As expected of a 
gathering hosted by the "Illustrious 
Clan." Everywhere I looked, there were 
famous faces...

Yes, what Daiichi Ruby asked the other day 
was for myself and K.S.Miracle to attend 
the party.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"In order to draw even greater attention 
to the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, I personally 
made a request to my clan to hold this 
event."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Until now, the sprint division has 
received less spotlight compared to the 
royal road of middle- and long-distance 
races.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
However, the tide is turning. That is 
why—we must give it one more push right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"As one of the leading contenders in the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen, we have come to ask 
if Miracle-san's camp would be willing to 
lend us their support as well."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"If we can invite influential figures and 
gain their high expectations here— it will 
add even greater significance to the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"If one is to offer something, it should 
be a more dazzling, more noble glory. 
...Do you not agree?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I see. This isn't the time to hold 
back, is it?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"To repay everyone even more. To make the 
miracle we bring to everyone shine even 
brighter... Ruby prepared this stage for 
us."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll do my best to make an impression. 
With confidence, just like her."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Would you come with me, too?

To be honest, I was still feeling 
hesitant, but instead of scolding myself, 
I forced the firmest nod I could muster.

For the sake of K.S. Miracle, who wishes 
to give the greatest repayment and deepest 
gratitude possible. ...I will do 
everything within my power to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Refined Gentleman
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. Might I have a moment of your 
time? I had the pleasure of watching your 
truly magnificent run in last year's Mile 
CS.

She managed to push through at first on 
sheer willpower, but high society is not 
so forgiving. The overwhelming tension 
gradually made her dizzy—

Before I knew it, Daiichi Ruby had come to 
my side and was entertaining the 
distinguished guests in my place.

text_block_list.name: Gorgeous Woman
text_block_list.text:
—My, engaging in such advanced training! 
As expected of two athletes competing at 
the forefront of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Gorgeous Man
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, this certainly makes me look forward 
to the Takamatsunomiya Kinen as well! I 
have already secured VIP seats, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gorgeous Man
text_block_list.text:
And if that's the case... will this 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen serve as a milestone 
for you, Lady Ruby?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Gorgeous Woman
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, ever since you changed your 
racing focus last year, haven't you 
achieved numerous feats? It is truly, 
utterly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Gorgeous Man
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes. On top of that, if you have run 
a splendid race in the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen, that is more than enough—no, more 
than plenty—for a graceful retirement.

text_block_list.name: Gorgeous Man
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? As the next head of the 
Illustrious Family, haven't you started 
considering passing the torch to the next 
generation soon?

text_block_list.name: Gorgeous Woman
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Looking ahead to the future, 
yes? Ah, by the way, if you wouldn't mind, 
I'd love to introduce you to my son—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I don't think... that's enough yet.

The sharp tone in her voice, so unlike her 
usual self, caught me off guard. It made 
me swallow the words I was about to retort 
with...

text_block_list.name: Gorgeous Woman
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Um, Lady Miracle...?"

With all eyes in the room fixed entirely 
upon her, K.S.Miracle quietly declared her 
stance.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
She... Ruby, will still... She will become 
faster, and faster still... mark my words.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ruby's brilliance hasn't... clouded in the 
slightest yet.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply grateful for your thoughtful 
consideration regarding my future... 
However,

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
My mission still lies upon the turf. 
Toward the further future, the further 
radiance I shall display with these legs—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please, continue to expect great things 
from us.

Even after that, many distinguished guests 
came by one after another to talk, but—

Recalling how the two of them looked 
earlier, I resolve myself and speak up.
choice_data_list: Excuse me! I'll take over from here.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh... Trainer?

I whisper quietly into the perked-up ear 
of a surprised K.S. Miracle.
choice_data_list: Go take a little break with Ruby

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer. ...Ruby, let's go.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(It's not that I thought you might not 
follow me. I just somehow... took your 
hand and walked.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Slipping out of the venue on the 
high-rise rooftop. Heading down the quiet, 
still staircase a bit—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Oh, the night view... is so beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Such multicolored brilliance... ...It's 
just like a jewelry box.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here, shall we head over to 
the window? How about it?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it really is beautiful... ...and a 
bit extravagant.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: A luxury?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"We're the only ones watching from here. 
So we get this whole jewel box all to 
ourselves—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that, I have you by my 
side. It's far more than I deserve."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Such a thing—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
But you know, Ruby. ...I'm glad it was 
you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That the one standing here with me right 
now... or waiting ahead for me in the 
future, is you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad it was you I got to compete 
against in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like it had to be you. I'm not 
sure why, and it's hard to put into words, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Shinning so brilliantly, glowing so 
dazzlingly crimson... You're the one I've 
always wanted to run with."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to give it everything I had and 
compete with you for the title of the 
fastest.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ruby, let's run together. Toward our 
future, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of my own dream. To repay 
everyone for everything they've done, I 
will claim the title of the fastest.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Let's settle this, Daiichi Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
In the name of the "Splendid Clan"— This 
time, I shall cut you down without mercy. 
K.S.Miracle.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Just before I returned to Trainer's 
side... the tip of Ruby's tail brushed 
ever so slightly against my leg.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Whether it was a coincidence or not. I 
don't know, but... let's just say it 
wasn't.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (I gave a little bit back in return, too.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...It's quite lively outside, isn't it?

Daiichi Ruby's plan seemed to have 
produced a tremendous effect. On the day 
of the “Takamatsunomiya Kinen,” the 
venue's excitement was at its peak.

"Seizing the title of the fastest right 
here would be an immense honor—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer? ...Are you feeling nervous?

However, that was the truth. After all, 
due to various overlapping circumstances, 
this marks her very first challenge in a 
sprint GⅠ.

The glory KS Miracle has aimed for ever 
since her debut. Whether she can seize it 
all comes down to today.

"That is precisely why— 'Did I do 
everything I could?' 'Was there something 
more I could have done?'"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Don't look down. ...Look at me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Look. I'm right here.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to everyone. ...Thanks to you, I 
made it this far.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You'll be just fine, Trainer. And of 
course, so will I.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please watch. Witness the power you guided 
me to.
